description: Na₃ScN₂ crystallizes in the cubic Ia̅3 space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.75 Å. Sc is bonded to four N atoms to form corner-sharing ScN₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (2.15 Å) and three longer (2.21 Å) Sc-N bond lengths. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a distorted hexagonal bipyramidal geometry to six equivalent Na and two equivalent Sc atoms. In the second N site, N is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six equivalent Na and two equivalent Sc atoms.
